Fictional Ebola outbreak surveillance Vusumuzi Mabasa and Sibusiso Mahlangu

Overview

Row

Interpretation

This dashboard reproduces a fictional training outbreak. It does not describe actual patients. Cases with missing dates or outcomes remain included in the completeness tables. The overview covers 5888 records; 256 lack onset dates and 1323 lack outcomes.

Link completeness

Of 3800 recorded infector links, 2161 have both endpoints in the cleaned line list. The remaining 1639 reference an absent identifier. Missing links are not reconstructed. The deterministic 80-case June subset displays 15 internal matched links.
